text:
alex: Quick sync — we had a p99 latency spike after the midnight deploy (2026-03-15 ~00:42 UTC). I want to run a focused k6 replay of ~120m of traffic (target window 00:30-02:30) to reproduce and collect CPU flamegraphs + KV cache metrics. Can someone own the run + profiling?

maria: I can spin up the k6 job, but which replay segments do you want? full-day or just the 00:30-01:30 slices?

alex: Let's do a narrow run first: segments 00:30-01:30 and 01:30-02:30 separately. s3://redwood-replays/2026-03-15/segments/ — use the included request_map.json to preserve ordering.

jonathan: I can handle profiling. Plan: run k6 with --rps throttling, capture perf (perf record -F 99 -g) on the router process, and run async-profiler for Java services. Which hosts will we target (prod sim vs staging)?

sam: Suggestion: run against the staging cluster with production traffic weights first. If reproduces, escalate to a small prod replay with strict abort rules. For k6 options: --vus 400 --duration 60m --rps 1000 with --ramp-up 5m. For the two 60m windows we can run sequentially.

pete: Add headers to preserve trace IDs so traces link back. Use X-Trace-Id: <from-replay> header injection. Also collect KV cache telemetry: GET /internal/debug/kv_stats on each pod every 2m. I can add a sidecar scrapes job.

alex: Good call. Also, set k6 env var REDWOOD_REPLAY_MODE=throttled so runtime adds extra logging.

ci-bot: Scheduled replay job #4567 by maria (k6). ETA start 1772125200. Logs will stream to https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/4567

maria: Starting run now on staging small pool. Command I used:
```
k6 run --out json=run-00-30.json --vus 400 --duration 60m --rps 900 --ramp-up 5m script_replay.js 
export REPLAY_SEGMENTS="s3://redwood-replays/2026-03-15/segments/00-30-01-30"
```

jonathan: Attaching perf on router-01 (PID 1423). Command: `perf record -F 99 -g -p 1423 -o /tmp/perf-router-00-30.data` and async-profiler for java: `./profiler.sh -d 60 -f /tmp/async-00-30.svg <java-pid>`

pete: Started KV scrape job collection. Posting a small script to poll endpoints:
```
for pod in $(kubectl get pods -l app=router -o name); do kubectl exec $pod -- curl -s http://localhost:7000/internal/debug/kv_stats >> kv_stats.log; done
```

leila: I'll generate flamegraphs after perf finishes and attach them here. Also will diff CPU stacks vs a baseline run from 2026-03-10.

natalie: I'll monitor SLOs. Abort condition: p99 > 2000ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows or error-rate > 1%. I'll post updates.

maria: first 60m run finished. Initial summary: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~420ms, p99 spiked to ~1.8s at 00:42 for ~3m then fell. Uploading artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/4567/artifacts

jonathan: perf data looks interesting — a big hotspot in kv-cache lookup on the router (stack includes route -> kv_client -> resolver). async-profiler shows heavy GC cycles on embedding service around the same timestamps.

pete: KV stats show a transient drop in hit-rate from 96% -> 82% at 00:41. We have concurrent eviction chatter.

alex: OK this aligns with the prod alert. Next steps: 1) run the second 60m window with slightly lower RPS to see stability (sam will run with --rps 700), 2) jonathan will run a focused micro-replay hitting the KV-heavy endpoints to isolate resolver lock contention, 3) leila will produce flamegraph diffs.

sam: kicking off second run with `--rps 700 --vus 300 --duration 60m`. will tag logs with run=kv-heavy-700

ci-bot: Scheduled replay job #4568 by sam. ETA start 1772125400.

leila: attaching first flamegraph (perf vs baseline): https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/4567/artifacts/flamegraph-00-30.svg — biggest delta in kv_client::resolve_path.

natalie: Watching SLOs now for run #4568. I'll abort if criteria hit.

alex: Thanks team. If second run reproduces the degradation with the lower RPS, we'll open a short incident and roll a quick fix (kv-client short-circuit and bump cache size). If it's stable, we'll schedule a longer soak during low-traffic hours and prepare a canary patch.

maria: All good from my side. Leaving run logs and replay steps in the job notes. @jonathan @pete please ping when you have the micro-replay results. :thumbsup:

jonathan: Will do. Planning the micro-replay for the identified KV endpoints in ~30m. Command snippet I'll use:
```
k6 run --duration 30m --vus 100 --rps 300 kv_hotspots_replay.js 
--env REPLAY_HEADER=X-Trace-Id
```

pete: I'll correlate kv_stats + traces and post a short doc with suggested mitigations.

leila: Leaving artifacts and SVGs in job #4567. Will post diffs here when ready.

alex: Perfect — thanks everyone. We'll reconvene here after the micro-replay. If anyone needs to swap ownership DM me.
